facts.value: Proper nutrition is as important to health as exercise.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: It is important to have a good diet to ensure that the body has the correct ratio of macronutrients while providing ample micronutrients to aid recovery following strenuous exercise.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Active recovery is recommended after participating in physical exercise because it removes lactate from the blood more quickly than inactive recovery.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Removing lactate from circulation allows for an easy decline in body temperature, which can benefit the immune system.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Exercise physiologists recommend the '4-Rs framework': Rehydration, Refuel, Repair, Rest.
